responsibility: Contains crate-level regression and behavior tests for the low-level lexer, exercising tokenization, raw-string delimiter parsing, shebang stripping, comment and literal classification, nesting behavior, and suffix handling to validate the public lexing surface defined in `lib.rs`.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` exercises the top-level lexer API and token formation in `lib.rs`—for example `tokenize`, `strip_shebang`, and raw-string delimiter scanning via `Cursor`—whereas the other `tests.rs` is scoped only to the `unescape` submodule’s literal-decoding routines and their `EscapeError`/range reporting.
